name: Personal Information Storage and Security Guardrail
what_it_decides: Mandates that personal identifiable information (PII) must be redacted or encrypted before transmission to external AI model endpoints.

name: Cross-Border Model Inference Disclosure Controls
what_it_decides: Controls cross-border disclosure of sensitive data to offshore LLM providers without equivalent statutory privacy safeguards.

name: Algorithm Transparency and Human Oversight Mandate
standard: Algorithm Charter for Aotearoa New Zealand
what_it_decides: Requires human-in-the-loop oversight and explainable audit trails for high-impact automated AI decision pipelines.

name: NZISM AI Telemetry and Data Classification Protection
what_it_decides: Enforces strict classification boundaries, audit retention, and encryption in transit for public sector and enterprise AI workloads.
